model:
rachana: 1
sutra: jurisdiction
version: 2
description: 
match: { kind: jurisdiction, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: "Politics and society · Jurisdiction", id: "$.JURISDICTION_ID" }
strip:
  - { label: "Country", bind: "$.NAME", emphasis: true }
  - { label: "Capital", bind: "$.CAPITAL" }
  - { label: "Government", bind: "$.GOVERNMENT_TYPE" }
  - { label: "Population (m)", bind: "$.POPULATION_M", fmt: "price2" }
  - { label: "Area (km2)", bind: "$.AREA_KM2", fmt: "amount0" }
  - { label: "Currency", bind: "$.CURRENCY" }
panels:
  - id: geography
    kind: map
    title: "Where it is"
    height: 11
    highlight: "$.ISO3"
    link: { kind: "jurisdiction", id: "JUR-{iso3}" }
  - id: legislature
    kind: table
    title: "Seats by party, lower chamber"
    key: "F2"
    rows: "$.LEGISLATURE"
    columns:
      - { label: "Party", bind: "@.PARTY" }
      - { label: "Seats", bind: "@.SEATS", fmt: "amount0", total: true }
  - id: indicators
    kind: table
    title: "Society and governance (latest)"
    key: "F3"
    rows: "$.INDICATORS"
    columns:
      - { label: "Indicator", bind: "@.INDICATOR" }
      - { label: "Value", bind: "@.VALUE", fmt: "price2", total: true }
      - { label: "Year", bind: "@.YEAR" }
      - { label: "Unit", bind: "@.UNIT" }
  - id: profile
    kind: kv
    title: "Profile"
    area: right
    rows: "$.PROFILE"
  - id: partiesListed
    kind: table
    title: "Political parties (as published)"
    key: "F4"
    rows: "$.PARTIES_LISTED"
    columns:
      - { label: "Party", bind: "@.PARTY" }
  - id: source
    kind: kv
    title: "Data source and licence"
    area: right
    rows: "$.PROVENANCE"
  - id: built
    kind: provenance
    title: "How this view was built"
  - id: refs
    kind: links
    title: "Linked entities"
    code: "REFS"
    area: right
keys: { F7: "link($.REGION, 'region')", F8: "impact", F9: "raw" }
